metadata.title: PUBLIC SPATIAL GROUND-TRUTH METRICS & SOURCE EVALUATION

feasibility_gate_impact_for_microarea_b.SCIENTIFIC_RECOMMENDATION: Continue targeted public gazette / judicial auction extraction across Jardim das Nações to reach >= 8 parcels before launching replication.

classification_justification: Legitimate public sources (Diário Oficial and Judicial Auction Notices) demonstrate proven capability to connect municipal BCs to door numbers, lot identifiers, and subdivision blocks (Levels 2 and 3). In the pilot test, 5 of 6 parcels were incrementally upgraded from STREET_ONLY to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE. However, because coverage is documentary-driven and currently yields 5 usable parcels (short of the >= 8 threshold required for full Phase 2.3X replication), and because Level 4/5 vector parcel geometries are not openly downloadable in bulk, the source landscape is classified as PARTIAL_VALUE.
